```{r consortium-info, echo=FALSE}
# Add consortium-specific information here
consortium_info <- list(
  HuBMAP = "Human BioMolecular Atlas Program - mapping the human body at single-cell resolution",
  SenNet = "Cellular Senescence Network - understanding cellular senescence across tissues",
  HTAN = "Human Tumor Atlas Network - mapping tumor microenvironments"
)

# Set consortium name
consortium <- "HTAN"
```

# Overview

This notebook applies co-authorship network analysis methods to assess collaboration 
between researchers using documented in the publication reported by investigators 
from the **`r consortium`** Consortium, a biomedical mapping program funded by 
the National Institutes of Health (NIH). Networks were generated in the R processing
pipeline:
- Baseline network represents collaboration using all publications with individual authors.
- Internal collaboration network using publications documenting collaboration between multiple projects working within or between mapping program research divisions.

We assess the growth and evolution of collaboration in mapping programs using
annual, cumulative networks from using all publication author lists and 
calculate baseline network statistical. Nodes represent authors that 
participate in the mapping program research. For each author, we include: name,
role within the program, the year of an author's first publication in the program, 
the number of publications (i.e., overall, annual counts, and research division); 
and citation measures (i.e., total citations and citations weighed by the count 
of author per publication); centrality and prestige measures (i.e., degree,
betweenness centrality, closeness centrality, and eigenvector centrality). 
All analysis have applied to baseline network and internal collaboration 
partitioned network.

The layout of the network graph visualizations are generated in Gephi. Filters are described in *Load Network Data* section.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}

# Load Network Data

This loads data used to generate the baseline and partitioned co-authorship networks
for the `r consortium`. Node files provide data on authors in both networks and
the edge files provide relationships identified from the publication data set
and internal collaboration publication data subset.

```{r load-data}
# Load consortia division metadata
div_metadata <- 
  fread(here::here(div_metadata_file)) %>%
  select(project_id, division, division_type, division_name) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  filter(project_id == consortium) %>%
  rename("consortium"="project_id")

# Load consortia network node and edge list files
nodes <- 
  fread(file=here::here(nodes_file), 
           header=T, encoding="UTF-8") %>%
  mutate(role = factor(role, 
                       levels = c("Principal Investigator","Researcher")))
edges <- fread(file=here::here(edges_file), header=T,
                  encoding="UTF-8")

# Load consortia network node and edge list files
nodes_partition <- 
  fread(file=here::here(nodes_partition_file), 
           header=T, encoding="UTF-8") %>%
  mutate(role = factor(role, 
                       levels = c("Principal Investigator","Researcher")))
edges_partition <- 
  fread(file=here::here(edges_partition_file), header=T,
                  encoding="UTF-8")

# Clean up var names
var_names <- names(nodes_partition)
var_names <- str_replace_all(var_names,"cc_","")
names(nodes_partition) <- str_replace_all(var_names,"ic_","")
var_names <- names(edges_partition)
names(edges_partition) <- str_replace_all(var_names,"ic_","")  
rm(var_names)
nodes_partition$label <- nodes_partition$id

# Extract years from column names
pubs_cols <- grep("^pubs_[0-9]{4}$", names(nodes), value = TRUE)
years <- as.integer(gsub("pubs_", "", pubs_cols))
years <- sort(years)

# Add Internal Collaboration Score to node partition
nodes_partition <-
  nodes_partition %>%
  mutate(ict_score = 
           round((interdivision_collaboration/publications)-
                 (intradivision_collaboration/publications),2)) %>%
  select(id, label, role, publications, interdivision_collaboration,
         intradivision_collaboration, ict_score, starts_with("pubs_"),
         citations, weighted_citations)
```

*Relationships in the Network*

* Total records: `r nrow(edges)`

## Create Baseline and Partitioned Networks

Both the baseline and partitioned networks includes all authors and relationship
found across all years of the analysis. The network layout used the overall, 
baseline network, which provides a consistent layout used in all network graph 
visualizations.

```{r baseline-network}
# Create baseline igraph network
baseline_network <- 
  graph_from_data_frame(
  d = edges[, .(from, to, weight)],
  directed = FALSE,
  vertices = nodes
)

# Create filtered igraph network
partition_network <- 
  graph_from_data_frame(
  d = edges_partition[, .(from, to, weight)],
  directed = FALSE,
  vertices = nodes_partition
)
```

## Network Summaries

*Baseline Network:*

* Nodes: `r vcount(baseline_network)`
* Edges: `r ecount(baseline_network)`
* Density: `r round(edge_density(baseline_network), 5)`
* Components: `r components(baseline_network)$no`

*Partitioned Network:*

* Nodes: `r vcount(partition_network)`
* Edges: `r ecount(partition_network)`
* Density: `r round(edge_density(partition_network), 5)`
* Components: `r components(partition_network)$no`

*Partitions Impact on Network Size&*

* Nodes removed: `r vcount(baseline_network)-vcount(partition_network)`
* Edges removed: `r ecount(baseline_network)-ecount(partition_network)`
* Percent of nodes retained: `r round(vcount(partition_network)/vcount(baseline_network)*100, 2)` %
* Percent of edges retained: `r round(ecount(partition_network)/ecount(baseline_network)*100, 2)` %

# Generating Annual Co-authorship Network Sub-Graphs

A temporal analysis of co-authorship networks can be achieved through segmentation
of the publication records for a NIH mapping program by publication year to
generate time-sliced sub-graphs, which represent a annual period (in years) between the 
formation of a consortium and proceeding years of research and collaboration 
(e.g., 2018, 2018-2019, etc.). 

The `r consortium` baseline co-authorship network and periodic sub-graphs were 
created at the same time using data processing scripts **30_network_generation_functions.R** 
and **31_generate_coauthorship_networks.R**. The baseline graph captures all nodes 
and edges found the network, which is used to generate a common network layout that aids
comparison across periods. The analysis calculates two measures for each periodic subgraph:

1. **pub_{year}**, node variables that represents the cumulative publication 
counts associated with an author in the network during a temporal period.
2. **weight_{year}**, edge variables that represents the cumulative collaborations 
(i.e., edge) between two authors in the network during a temporal period.

Note that cumulative citation counts are not calculated for nodes in the network, 
because the citation variable is an aggregated count provided by a third party 
(e.g., Web of Science or Google Scholar).

### Network Filtering Function

Annual co-authorship network sub-graphs are generated using the _create_annual_network()_ 
function. The function loops through years identified in the baseline network column set, 
where the relevant node and edge variables (i.e.,**pub_{year}** and **weight_{year}**) 
for a given sub-graphs are used to filter baseline the node and egde lists to 
keep nodes and edges with values greater than to zero, which indicates that 
an author or a relationship had not yet been established in the publication record 
during the period.

```{r create-annual-network-function}
# Create annual network by filtering baseline network
# @param year Year to create network for
# @param nodes Node data.table
# @param edges Edge data.table
# @param graph is an igraph object
# @return List containing igraph object and metadata
create_annual_network <- function(year, nodes, edges, graph) {
  
  # Column names for this year
  pubs_col <- paste0("pubs_", year)
  weight_col <- paste0("weight_", year)
  
  # Validate columns exist
  if (!pubs_col %in% names(nodes)) {
    warning(paste("Column", pubs_col, "not found"))
    return(NULL)
  }
  if (!weight_col %in% names(edges)) {
    warning(paste("Column", weight_col, "not found"))
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Filter nodes: authors with publications through this year
  active_nodes <- nodes[get(pubs_col) > 0]
  active_node_ids <- active_nodes$id
  
  # Filter edges: collaborations through this year
  active_edges <- edges[get(weight_col) > 0]
  
  # Create induced subgraph
  g_year <- induced_subgraph(
    graph,
    vids = V(graph)[name %in% active_node_ids]
  )
  
  # Get edge list for the subgraph
  el <- as_edgelist(g_year)
  edge_ids <- paste(el[,1], el[,2], sep = "|")
  
  # Match edges and get weights
  edge_weights <- numeric(length(edge_ids))
  for (i in seq_along(edge_ids)) {
    parts <- strsplit(edge_ids[i], "\\|")[[1]]
    match_idx <- which(
      (active_edges$from == parts[1] & active_edges$to == parts[2]) |
      (active_edges$from == parts[2] & active_edges$to == parts[1])
    )
    if (length(match_idx) > 0) {
      edge_weights[i] <- active_edges[[weight_col]][match_idx[1]]
    }
  }
  
  # Remove edges with zero weight
  edges_to_keep <- which(edge_weights > 0)
  if (length(edges_to_keep) < ecount(g_year)) {
    g_year <- delete_edges(g_year, E(g_year)[-edges_to_keep])
    edge_weights <- edge_weights[edges_to_keep]
  }
  
  # Set edge weights
  E(g_year)$weight <- edge_weights
  
  # Add node attributes
  node_match <- match(V(g_year)$name, active_nodes$id)
  V(g_year)$year <- year
  V(g_year)$pubs_cumulative <- active_nodes[[pubs_col]][node_match]
  
  return(g_year)
}
```

### Generate Annual Networks Sub-Graphs

```{r generate-annual-networks, echo=TRUE}
# Create networks for all years - baseline network data
annual_networks <- list()
for (year in years) {
  cat("Creating ", year, "network\n")
  
  g_year <- 
    create_annual_network(
    year = year,
    nodes = nodes,
    edges = edges,
    graph = baseline_network
  )
  
  if (!is.null(g_year)) {
    annual_networks[[as.character(year)]] <- g_year
    cat("  Nodes:", vcount(g_year), "| Edges:", ecount(g_year), "\n")
  }
}  

# Create annual networks for all years - partitioned network data
annual_partition_networks <- list()
for (year in years) {
  cat("Creating", year, "network\n")
  
  g_year <- create_annual_network(
    year = year,
    nodes = nodes_partition,
    edges = edges_partition,
    graph = partition_network
  )
  
  if (!is.null(g_year)) {
    annual_partition_networks[[as.character(year)]] <- g_year
    cat("  Nodes:", vcount(g_year), "| Edges:", ecount(g_year), "\n")
  }
}
```

There were `r length(annual_networks)` annual networks created for the consortium.

There were `r length(annual_partition_networks)` annual partitioned networks created for the consortium.

# Network Analysis

## Comprehensive Metrics Function

After generating the annual co-authorship sub-graphs for `r consortium`, each network is 
analyzed to across a set of network statistical measures. The annualized measures allow 
for temporal t
rend analysis of the network growth over the observation period.

Calculations are made with consideration that each co-authorship networks are weighed and 
undirected, unless otherwise noted. The `calculate_comprehensive_metrics()` function is 
used to measure the following network statistics: 
* Network size: node and edge count.
* Density
* Number of Components 
* Diameter (edge weights unused)
* Avg. Path Length (edge weights unused)
* Number of Triangles
* Clustering Coefficient
* Modularity (using Louvain community detection algorithm)
* Avg. Degree 
* Std. Dev. Degree
* Max. Degree
* Avg. Publication Count
* Std. Dev. Publication Count
* Avg. Citation Count
* Std. Dev. Citation Count

Note, alternative community detection and clustering algorithms may be tested. 
The Louvain clustering algorithm is used here due to the quality of clusters 
identification when this algorithm is applied to co-authorship networks.

```{r calculate-metrics-function, include=FALSE}
# Calculate comprehensive network metrics
# @param g igraph object
# @param year Year label
# @param consortium Consortium label
# @return Data frame with all metrics
calculate_comprehensive_metrics <- 
  function(g, year, consortium, net_type = c("baseline", "partition")) {
  
    if (is.null(g) || vcount(g) == 0) {
      return(NULL)
    }
    
    # Basic network properties
    n_nodes <- vcount(g)
    n_edges <- ecount(g)
    
    # Density
    density <- edge_density(g)
    
    # Components
    comp <- components(g)
    n_components <- comp$no
    
    # Diameter and path lengths (only for connected graphs)
    is_connected <- is.connected(g)
    if (is_connected) {
      diameter <- diameter(g, weights = NA, directed = FALSE,
                           unconnected = FALSE)
      avg_path_length <- mean_distance(g, weights = NA, directed = FALSE,
                           unconnected = FALSE)
    } else {
      diameter <- diameter(g, weights = NA, directed = FALSE,
                           unconnected = TRUE)
      avg_path_length <- mean_distance(g, weights = NA, directed = FALSE,
                           unconnected = TRUE)
    }
    
    # Number of triangles
    n_triangles <- sum(count_triangles(g)) / 3
    
    # Clustering coefficient
    clustering_coef <- transitivity(g, type = "global")
    
    # Modularity (using community detection)
    if (n_edges > 0) {
      communities <- cluster_louvain(g, weights = E(g)$weight)
      modularity_score <- modularity(communities)
    } else {
      modularity_score <- NA
    }
    
    # Degree statistics
    degree_ct <- degree(g, loops = FALSE)
    avg_degree <- mean(degree_ct, na.rm = TRUE)
    sd_degree <- sd(degree_ct, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    # Publication and citation statistics
    avg_publications <- mean(V(g)$publications)
    sd_publications <- sd(V(g)$publications, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    if ("citations" %in% vertex_attr_names(g)) {
      avg_citations <- mean(V(g)$citations, na.rm = TRUE)
      sd_citations <- sd(V(g)$citations, na.rm = TRUE)
    } else {
      avg_citations <- NA
      sd_citations <- NA
    }
    
    # Return metrics as data frame
    data.frame(
        consortia = consortium,
        network = net_type,
        year = year,
        node_count = n_nodes,
        edge_count = n_edges,
        number_of_components = n_components,
        network_density = density,
        diameter = diameter,
        average_path_length = avg_path_length,
        number_of_triangles = n_triangles,
        clustering_coefficient = clustering_coef,
        modularity = modularity_score,
        avg_degree = avg_degree,
        sd_degreev = sd_degree,
        mean_publications = avg_publications,
        sd_publications = sd_publications,
        mean_citations = avg_citations,
        sd_citations = sd_citations
      )
  }
```

## Calculate Metrics for All Years

```{r calculate-all-metrics, echo=FALSE}
# Calculate metrics for each annual network - Baseline Data
annual_metrics <-
  map_dfr(names(annual_networks), function(year) {
  calculate_comprehensive_metrics(
    g = annual_networks[[year]],
    year = as.integer(year),
    consortium = consortium,
    net_type = "baseline"
  )
})

# Calculate metrics for each annual network - Filtered Data
annual_partition_metrics <-
  map_dfr(names(annual_partition_networks), function(year) {
  calculate_comprehensive_metrics(
    g = annual_partition_networks[[year]],
    year = as.integer(year),
    consortium = consortium,
    net_type = "partition"
  )
})

# Combine network metrics data
network_metrics_t <- 
  network_metrics <- 
  rbind(annual_metrics,
        annual_partition_metrics) %>%
  mutate(network = factor(network, 
                          levels=c("baseline","partition"),
                          labels=c("Baseline Network", "IC Partition Network")))

# Update col names to upper case without underscores.
colnames(network_metrics_t) <-
  str_to_title(str_replace_all(colnames(network_metrics_t),"_"," "))

rm(annual_metrics, annual_filtered_metrics)

# Display metrics table
network_metrics_t %>% 
  select(-Consortia) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric) & 
                  !c(Year, 'Node Count', 'Edge Count', 'Number Of Triangles',
                     'Number Of Components'), 
                ~round(., 4))) %>%
  kable(caption = paste("Table 3. ",consortium," annual co-authorship network metrics."))
```

## Growth Rate Analysis

The co-authorship networks rate of growth is calculated for the period 2019 to 
2025. The years 2018 and 2026 are excluded due to the limited data points 
available for these years.

```{r growth-rates, echo=FALSE}
# Calculate year-over-year growth rates (2019-2026)
growth_stats_baseline <- 
  network_metrics %>%
  arrange(year) %>%
  filter(network=="Baseline Network",
         year>min(year),
         year<max(year)) %>%
  mutate(
    node_growth_pct = (node_count / lag(node_count) - 1) * 100,
    edge_growth_pct = (edge_count / lag(edge_count) - 1) * 100
  ) %>%
  select(network, year, node_count, node_growth_pct, edge_count, edge_growth_pct) %>%
  mutate(
    node_growth_pct = round(node_growth_pct, 2),
    edge_growth_pct = round(edge_growth_pct, 2)
  )

growth_stats_partition <- 
  network_metrics %>%
  arrange(year) %>%
  filter(network=="IC Partition Network",
         year>min(year),
         year<max(year)) %>%
  mutate(
    node_growth_pct = (node_count / lag(node_count) - 1) * 100,
    edge_growth_pct = (edge_count / lag(edge_count) - 1) * 100
  ) %>%
  select(network, year, node_count, node_growth_pct, edge_count, edge_growth_pct) %>%
  mutate(
    node_growth_pct = round(node_growth_pct, 2),
    edge_growth_pct = round(edge_growth_pct, 2)
  )

growth_stats <- 
  rbind(growth_stats_baseline, growth_stats_partition)

rm(growth_stats_baseline, growth_stats_partition)

growth_stats %>%
  kable(
    caption = paste("Table 4. Co-authorshup network year-over-year growth rates."),
    col.names = c("Network", "Year", "Nodes", "Node Growth (%)", "Edges", "Edge Growth (%)")
  )
```

# Centrality Analysis

Next, network centrality measures are calculated to each `r consortium` annual 
co-authorship sub-graphs, which are weighted and undirected. Centrality measures
include:

* Degree centrality
* Betweenness centrality
* Eigenvector centrality

## Node-Level Centrality Measures

```{r calculate-centrality}
# Calculate node-level centrality metrics
#' @param g igraph object
#' @param year Year label
#' @return Data frame with centrality metrics
calculate_node_centrality <- 
  function(g, year, consortia, net_type = c("baseline","partition")) {
    if (is.null(g) || vcount(g) == 0) {
      return(NULL)
    }
    
    # Calculate centrality measures
    deg <- degree(g)
    
    # Betweenness centrality (can be slow for large networks)
    betw <- betweenness(g, weights = E(g)$weight, normalized = F)
    
    # Eigenvector centrality
    eigen <- eigen_centrality(g, weights = E(g)$weight)$vector
    
    # Create data frame
    data.frame(
      consortia = consortium,
      network = net_type,
      year = year,
      node_id = V(g)$name,
      node_label = V(g)$label,
      role = V(g)$role,
      degree = deg,
      betweenness_centrality = betw,
      eigenvector_centrality = eigen,
      publications = V(g)$pubs_cumulative,
      citations = if("citations" %in% vertex_attr_names(g)) V(g)$citations else NA
    )
}
```

```{r node_centrality, echo=FALSE}
# Calculate centrality for all years baseline network
centrality_metrics_baseline <- 
  map_dfr(names(annual_networks), function(year) {
    calculate_node_centrality(
      annual_networks[[year]], 
      as.integer(year),
      consortia = consortium,
      net_type="baseline")
  })

# Calculate centrality for all years partition networks
centrality_metrics_partition <- 
  map_dfr(names(annual_partition_networks), function(year) {
    calculate_node_centrality(
      annual_partition_networks[[year]], 
      as.integer(year), 
      consortia = consortium,
      net_type="partition")
  })

# Combine network metrics data
centrality_metrics <- 
  rbind(centrality_metrics_baseline,
        centrality_metrics_partition) %>%
  mutate(network = factor(network, 
                          levels=c("baseline","partition"),
                          labels=c("Baseline Network", "IC Partition Network"))) %>%
  remove_rownames()

rm(centrality_metrics_baseline, centrality_metrics_partition)

# Display top nodes by betweenness (most recent year)
recent_year <- max(years)-1

centrality_metrics_t <- 
  centrality_metrics %>%
    filter(year == recent_year,
           network== "Baseline Network") %>%
    arrange(desc(betweenness_centrality)) %>%
    head(10) 

centrality_metrics_t %>%
  rbind(centrality_metrics %>%
            filter(year == recent_year,
                   network== "IC Partition Network") %>%
            arrange(desc(betweenness_centrality)) %>%
            head(10)) %>%
  select(network, node_label, role, publications, degree, 
         betweenness_centrality, eigenvector_centrality) %>%
  rename_with(~ str_to_title(gsub("_", " ", .x, fixed = TRUE))) %>%
  kable(caption = paste("Table 5. Top 10 authors by betweenness centrality -", recent_year,"."),
        row.names = FALSE)
```

# Relationship Analysis

## Assign Relationship Type

In this analysis, the types of relationships that are assigned to an edge is based
on the identified roles of the authors in a dyad. There are three types of relationships 
possible in the network: PI dyads & researcher dyads, where authors' share the same
role in the network; and mixed dyads, where authors have different roles in the 
network.

```{r edge_type_analyis}
edges$edge_type <- "Mixed Dyad"
edges_t <-
  edges %>%
    select(to,from,weight,edge_type) %>%
    left_join(nodes %>%
                mutate(id = as.character(id)) %>%
                select(id, role),
              join_by("to" == "id")) %>%
    left_join(nodes %>%
                select(id,role),
              join_by("from" == "id")) %>%
    rename("to_role" = "role.x",
           "from_role" = "role.y")

# Update edge type for researchers and PIs
edges_t[edges_t$to_role=="Researcher" & 
        edges_t$from_role=="Researcher",]$edge_type <- "Researcher Dyad"
edges_t[edges_t$to_role=="Principal Investigator" & 
        edges_t$from_role=="Principal Investigator",]$edge_type <- "PI Dyad"

# Convert edge_type to factor variable
edges_t$edge_type <- factor(edges_t$edge_type, 
                            levels=c("PI Dyad","Researcher Dyad","Mixed Dyad"))

# Network IC Partition
edges_partition $edge_type <- "Mixed Dyad"
edges_p <-
  edges_partition %>%
    select(to,from,weight,edge_type) %>%
    left_join(nodes %>%
                mutate(id = as.character(id)) %>%
                select(id, role),
              join_by("to" == "id")) %>%
    left_join(nodes %>%
                select(id,role),
              join_by("from" == "id")) %>%
    rename("to_role" = "role.x",
           "from_role" = "role.y")

# Update edge type for researchers and PIs
edges_p[edges_p$to_role=="Researcher" & 
        edges_p$from_role=="Researcher",]$edge_type <- "Researcher Dyad"
edges_p[edges_p$to_role=="Principal Investigator" & 
        edges_p$from_role=="Principal Investigator",]$edge_type <- "PI Dyad"

# Convert edge_type to factor variable
edges_p$edge_type <- factor(edges_p$edge_type, 
                            levels=c("PI Dyad","Researcher Dyad","Mixed Dyad"))
```

## Relationship Type Census and Weight Statistics

```{r edge_type_census, echo=FALSE}
edge_type <- 
  edges_t %>%
  group_by(edge_type) %>%
  summarise(relationships = n(),
            mean_weight = mean(weight),
            sd_weight = sd(weight),
            var_weight = var(weight),
            min_weight = min(weight),
            max_weight = max(weight)) %>%
  mutate(percent_of_relationships = 
           round(relationships/nrow(edges),2)) %>%
  select(edge_type,relationships,percent_of_relationships,
         mean_weight, sd_weight, var_weight, min_weight, max_weight)

colnames(edge_type) <-
  colnames(edge_type) %>%
  str_replace_all("_"," ") %>%
  str_to_title()

edge_type %>%
   kable(caption = paste("Table 6. ",consortium," relationship type census, all edges."))
```

```{r edge_type_census_partition, echo=FALSE}
edge_type_p <- 
  edges_p %>%
  filter(weight>1) %>%
  group_by(edge_type) %>%
  summarise(relationships = n(),
            mean_weight = mean(weight),
            sd_weight = sd(weight),
            var_weight = var(weight),
            max_weight = max(weight)) %>%
  select(edge_type,relationships, mean_weight, sd_weight, var_weight, max_weight)

colnames(edge_type_p) <-
  colnames(edge_type_p) %>%
  str_replace_all("_"," ") %>%
  str_to_title()

edge_type_p <-
  edge_type_p %>%
  left_join(edge_type %>% select("Edge Type","Relationships"),
            by = "Edge Type") %>%
  mutate("Percent of Baseline Relationships"= round(Relationships.x/Relationships.y,2)) %>%
  rename("Relationships (Partition)" = "Relationships.x",
         "Relationships (Baseline)" = "Relationships.y") 

edge_type_p[,c(1,7,2,8,3:6)] %>%  
  kable(caption = paste("Table 8. ",consortium," principal investigator relationships with at least 10 collaborations."))
```

# Internal Collaboration

## Distribution of Collaboration Type Concentration Scores for NIH Mapping Program Authors

```{r histogram-author-distribution_ict_score+role, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE, fig.cap="**Figure 8.** A histogram shows the distribution of authors' internal collaboration type (ICT) scores for NIH mapping program; bar color identifies number of the collaborative authors by role within a program. An ICT score of 1 indicates that an division only engages in inter-division research; a score of -1 indicates that an division only engages in intra-division collaboration; a score of 0 indicates that an division engages in both inter- and intra-division equally.", fig.height=3, fig.width=5}
#### Histogram of author internal collaboration type concentration score. ####
# A Internal Collaboration Type Score represents the concentration and type of 
# internal collaborative research and concentration that an author engages. 
# There are two types of internal collaboration: inter-division (between) vs. 
# intra-division (within) collaborations.
#
# Interpretation: An ICT Score of 1 indicates that 
# an author only engages in  inter-division research; a score of -1 indicates 
# that an author only engages in intra-division collaboration; a score of 0  
# indicates that an author engages in both inter- and intra-division equally.

# geom_segment color data set.
gradient_data <- data.frame(
  collaboration_type_concentration = seq(-1.07,1.07,.001), 
  color = seq(-1.07,1.07,.001) )

# Plot
p8 <- 
  nodes_partition %>%
    select(role, ict_score, publications) %>%
    filter(is.na(ict_score)==FALSE) %>%
    ggplot() +
      geom_segment(data = gradient_data, alpha = .15,
                   aes(x=color, xend=color,
                       y=0, yend=Inf, color=color),
                   show.legend = FALSE) +
      annotate("text", x=-.85, y=1300, size=2, color="#6B6443",
               label="Intradivision\nCollaborations") +
      annotate("text", x=.85, y=1300, size=2, color="#3F6B40",
               label="Interdivision\nCollaborations") +
      annotate("text", x=0, y=1300, size=2, color="#444444",
               label="Mixed Collaboration\nTypes") +
      geom_histogram(aes(x = ict_score, fill = role),
                     binwidth=.1, color="#9E9E9E1E") + 
      scale_x_continuous(limits=c(-1.07,1.07), breaks=seq(-1,1,.1),
                         expand=c(0,0)) +
      scale_y_continuous(trans="sqrt", limits=c(0,1600)) +
      scale_color_gradient2(low="#ffeda0", mid="white", high="#87C980",
                            midpoint=0) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("Principal Investigator" = "#9964A8", 
                                   "Researcher" = "#6D99D5")) +
      labs(x = "Internal Collaboration Type Score",
           y = "Authors (Square Root Scale)",
           fill = "Author Role") +
      theme(legend.position = "bottom",
            legend.box.just = "left",
            panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "#E0E0E0"),
            panel.grid.minor.y = element_line(colour = "#E0E0E0"),
            panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
            panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank())

ggsave(
  filename = here::here(paste0("outputs/figures/",consortium,
                               "-histogram_author_distribution_ict_score+role.svg")), 
  plot = p8, 
  width = 5, 
  height = 3, 
  units = "in")

p8
```

# Exporting Networks and Network Measures

## Save centrality measurements and network metrics

```{r save-network_metrics}
#### Combine baseline and partitioned node and edge lists for Gephi visualization ####
# Node list
nodes_c <- 
  nodes %>%
  left_join(nodes_partition %>%
              select(-label, -role),
            by="id")
name_vars <- 
  names(nodes_c) %>%
  str_replace_all("\\.y","_ic") %>%
  str_replace_all("\\.x","")
names(nodes_c) <- name_vars

nodes_c <-
  nodes_c %>%
  mutate(ic_partition = ifelse(is.na(publications_ic) == T, 0, 1)) %>%
  select(id, label, role, first_publication_year, publications, publications_ic,
         citations, citations_ic, weighted_citations, weighted_citations_ic, 
         interdivision_collaboration, intradivision_collaboration, ict_score,
         ic_partition, starts_with("pubs_", ignore.case = F))

node_file <- 
  file.path(data_dir,
            paste0(consortium, 
                   "_coauthorship-baseline_partition_combined-nodes.csv"))
write.csv(nodes_c, file=here::here(node_file), row.names = F)

# Edge List
edges_c <- 
  edges %>%
  left_join(edges_partition %>%
              select(normalized_edge, weight) %>%
              rename("ic" = "weight"),
            by="normalized_edge") %>%
  mutate(ic_partition = ifelse(is.na(ic)==T,0,1)) %>%
  select(normalized_edge, from, to, source, target, weight, ic, ic_partition,
         starts_with("weight_", ignore.case = F)) %>%
  rename("weight_ic" = "ic")
  
edge_file <- 
  file.path(data_dir,
            paste0(consortium, 
                   "_coauthorship-baseline_partition_combined-edges.csv"))
write.csv(edges_c, file=here::here(edge_file), row.names = F)
rm(edge_file, node_file)

# Save each annual baseline network as RDS
for (year in names(annual_networks)) {
  network_file <- file.path(output_dir,"rds",
                            paste0(consortium, "_coauthorship_network-", year, ".rds"))
  saveRDS(annual_networks[[year]], here::here(network_file))
}
# Save annual filtered networks as RDS
for (year in names(annual_partition_networks)) {
  network_file <- file.path(output_dir,"rds",
                            paste0(consortium, "_coauthorship_network-p-", year, ".rds"))
  saveRDS(annual_partition_networks[[year]], here::here(network_file))
}

# Save network metrics to CSV
metrics_file <- file.path(output_dir,"tables",
                          paste0(consortium,"-coauthorship_network_annual_metrics.csv"))

write_csv(network_metrics, 
          file=here::here(metrics_file))

# Combined data set for comparative analysis
metrics_c_file <- file.path(output_dir,"tables",
                            paste0("NIH_map-program_coauthorship_network_annual_metrics.csv"))

if(file.exists(here::here(metrics_c_file))==FALSE){
  write_delim(network_metrics, 
          file=here::here(metrics_c_file),
          na = "NA", delim=",", quote="needed")
} else {
  write_delim(network_metrics, 
          file=here::here(metrics_c_file),
          append = TRUE,
          na = "NA", delim=",", quote="needed")
}

# Save network centrality measures to CSV
centrality_file <- 
  file.path(output_dir,"tables",
            paste0(consortium, "-coauthorship_node_centrality_annual_metrics.csv"))
write_csv(centrality_metrics, 
          file=here::here(centrality_file))

# Save to a combined data set for comparative temporal analysis data set
centrality_file_c <- 
  file.path(output_dir,"tables",
            paste0("NIH_map-program_coauthorship_node_centrality_annual_metrics.csv"))

if(file.exists(here::here(centrality_file_c))==FALSE){
  write_delim(centrality_metrics, 
          file=here::here(centrality_file_c),
          na = "NA", delim=",", quote="needed")
} else {
  write_delim(centrality_metrics, 
          file=here::here(centrality_file_c),
          append = TRUE,
          na = "NA", delim=",", quote="needed")
}
